headline: Stlican Shelf Flares While Passage Falls Quiet
war_summary: Since the midday edition the centre of action has shifted to Stlican Shelf with eight changes in two hours and 32 on the day to 14:44 about Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, holdings now two Warden, six Colonial and one neutral with day losses of 2,224 Colonial and 2,616 Warden and both casualty rates accelerating in the last hour. Fisherman's Row has stirred again with three changes in two hours and 36 on the day to 14:57 about Eidolo, Black Well and Dankana Post, holdings three Warden and six Colonial. Nevish Line likewise counts three changes in two hours and ten on the day to 14:34 about Grief Mother and Tomb Father, holdings seven Warden and one neutral with heavy day losses of 4,896 Colonial and 4,209 Warden. Palantine Berm adds three changes in two hours about Leiri Hermanni, holdings seven Warden, while Godcrofts shows two about Argosa, holdings eight Colonial and one neutral. Weathered Expanse has cooled to one change in two hours though 62 on the day about Frostmarch, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest, holdings five Warden and four Colonial, and Callahan's Passage and Mooring County have gone quiet in the last two hours.
